summary: A ticketed countryside New Year celebration combining Lanna entertainment, dinner, lanterns and fireworks. The seller now explicitly advertises 31 December 2026 under the title Countdown 2027; this is a substantial evening commitment rather than a quick city-centre stop.
whyGo: One organised booking combines dinner, performances and the midnight spectacle.
A dramatic setting for travellers who prioritise celebration photographs.
bestFor: Couples and groups wanting a planned New Year evening.
Travellers comfortable returning to Chiang Mai well after midnight.
skipIf: You want a low-cost, flexible evening near your hotel.
Loud fireworks, crowds or a late return would spoil the experience.
duration: Reserve the entire evening, approximately eight hours including assembly and transfers; hotel arrival may be later.
cost: Published tickets: THB 4,900–15,900 per person. Allow extra for reaching the meeting point and returning from the city drop-off to your hotel; verify the selected class total before paying.
hours: Advertised for 31 December 2026 into 1 January 2027. Meeting-point assembly begins at 17:30; the listing ends at 01:00. Timings may shift.
bestTime: Arrive near the start of the stated assembly window and keep the following morning free.
gettingThere: Venue: CAD Cultural Lanna, On Klang, Mae On. The seller advertises transfers from Central Chiang Mai Airport mall, near Go Wholesale parking. Confirm the precise pickup pin and return drop-off for your ticket.
booking: Advance online booking is available through Top Destinations, which identifies itself as an authorised CAD agent. Tickets are stated to be non-refundable. The checkout says credit cards only and e-tickets normally arrive by email within 12 hours; save the receipt and ticket offline.
accessibility: Step-free routes, accessible toilets and wheelchair-capable transfers are not documented. Ask for written confirmation before buying if these are essential.
practicalTips: Carry a warm layer, charged phone and ear protection if sensitive to fireworks.
Check dietary needs and transfer arrangements before committing to a non-refundable purchase.
Save your hotel address for the final journey from the drop-off.
decemberNotes: Use the 31 December 2026 itinerary when checking availability: Countdown 2027 refers to the incoming year. The site also sells a separate 30 December event, so inspect the date carefully.
uncertainties: The homepage contains an impossible November date and inconsistent package names; verify date, class and inclusions on the issued ticket.
Final programme, accessibility and exact return time remain unconfirmed.
